voice.title: Voice Intake
voice.subtitle: Press the microphone icon to speak your health concerns in your mother tongue.

voice.transcriptPlaceholder: Describe symptoms here or click the microphone to speak... (e.g., 'Severe chest pain radiating to left arm since 2 hours')

bodymap.subtitle: Touch the affected body regions on the diagram to indicate where you feel pain or discomfort.

voice.main: Please touch the area where you feel pain or discomfort.
voice.pairedSelect: Which side is affected? Please select left, right, or both.
voice.specificSelect: Please select the exact part that is painful.

understanding.title: AI Understanding & Clinical Extraction
understanding.subtitle: MedNova has analyzed the clinical voice and text input into structured medical entities.

understanding.codeMixedNote: Analyzed and preserved original patient dialect

adcp.title: Adaptive Dynamic Case Path (ADCP)
adcp.subtitle: Relevant follow-up questions tailored to your primary symptoms and clinical risks.
adcp.answerHelp: Select the most accurate response to help the doctor prepare:

questions.painLocation: Where exactly is the pain located?
questions.painLocationDesc: Is the discomfort centralized or spreading to your shoulder, neck, or back?
questions.symptomDuration: How long have you had these symptoms?
questions.painType: What kind of pain is it?
questions.breathingDifficulty: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or whistling sound?
questions.feverChills: Do you have high fever, chills, or cold shivers?
questions.sweatingRadiation: Is there severe cold sweating, nausea, or dizziness?
questions.bleedingSigns: Have you noticed any bleeding (gums, nose, vomiting, or dark stools)?
